About Us
Gullak has been helping everyday savers grow their money since 2015. We started with a simple idea — that saving small amounts daily, with someone you trust, can change lives. Today, families across India trust Gullak with their daily, monthly, and one-time savings, backed by transparent practices and a network of local collection agents you can meet face to face.
